description: Return the link to download Buffet (iOS, free) and, when an event id is given, the link for that pick. Use when the person wants to join a pick, get a plate, or install the app. The link goes to joinbuffet.com/get/, which forwards to the App Store and records which assistant sent them.

assistant.description: Which assistant is asking: claude or chatgpt. Omit if unsure.

event_id.description: Optional event id to attribute the link to
